svg.title: Noble Advisory Group — M04 Twin Architectural Bridge
svg.desc: Two smaller mirrored M01 pylon designs, with native M01 cable launch geometry, original M01 tapered outer pylon sockets, seven unobtrusive inward stays per arch, 26 deck-anchored cables, patinated teal deck and registered structural piers.
